title: Instruments around Napoleonville plantations
summary: Asked when horns and pianos arrived, Mrs. Cary says only that there was music when she was a young lady and no plantation fiddlers.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: When did they start getting any kind of musical instruments, any horns or pianos or anything out there in Donaldsonville?
Yeah. Well I tell you, I couldn't tell you exactly what I know. After I was a young lady, I used to have music out in Napoleonville, horns and everything else. I was a young lady and then.
They didn't have any fiddlers around the plantation?
Fiddlers in the plantation? No, they had any plantations there.
